assets.title: S01 Kitchen Work Cabinet
assets.description: Original 1.2m working cabinet with continuous frame, recessed plinth, fixed shallow drawer cavity, inner shelf and independently editable left door. Furniture interface family: 0.6m base width,0.6m depth,0.9m top. Design-language comparison to prior sink cabinet, not a same-function replacement. Independent editable hinge node and the finite tested poses recorded in door_motion; no animation, continuous-motion, load or physics claim.

assets.title: S01 Open Base Cabinet

Independent editable components in fixed static display pose; no moving mechanisms, animation, load or physics claim.

assets.title: S01 Three Drawer Cabinet
